consequence.statement: Composite resources no longer have native connection details support; operators relying on it must recreate the feature by composing their own connection details Secret.
consequence.remediation: Compose your own connection details Secret as described in the connection details composition guide.

assertion.statement: Native connection details support for composite resources (XRs) is removed; managed resources keep writeConnectionSecretToRef, and XR users must compose their own connection details Secret.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Text does not name the XR fields or config that signal use of native XR connection details, so exposure cannot be expressed.
